{{Otheruses|Truncheon}}
A '''stun truncheon''' was a [[Melee weapon/Legends|melee weapon]] capable of [[Stun/Legends|stunning]] a target. They were generally carried by [[Warden/Legends|wardens]] serving the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].
